findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “When is the last time you spoke the truth in love?”
findings.source_quote: God forbid, let us repent and remove the beams from our eyes so that we can help our brother!
findings.suggested_fix: 把“千万不要这样！让我们悔改”改为“断乎不可！让我们悔改”，以保留“God forbid”表达的强烈否定语气。
findings.translation_quote: 千万不要这样！让我们悔改，除掉自己眼中的梁木，好帮助我们的弟兄！
